status: Partial implementation; two source records, not two certified complete ports.
attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors; source-derived behavior summaries licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Original implementation, tuning and test interpretation are distinguished below.

sources.supports: Exact Peep 68.0.0, Peep Eye 68.10.0; Bloat is 68.1.0, Bloat Eye 68.11.0. Peep base HP 450, stage HP 0, contact 2, radius 27. Eye source HP 450/contact 1/radius 13; local invulnerable HP sentinel is not a source HP conversion.

Yellow creep; varying eight-shot radial burst; player-directed jump with twelve-shot landing; detach eyes at two-thirds/one-third HP; whole-heart body contact. Cyan starts with both eyes; yellow is 15% smaller, faster, leaves constant creep. Named eye-kill exceptions.

Owned, invulnerable, non-gating eyes move diagonally over obstacles, bounce off walls/monsters, block tears, deal contact damage, respond to bombs, disappear on owner death. Article index/infobox tuple is overridden by installed XML identity.
Peep family belongs to Caves/Catacombs/Flooded Caves main-route pools; bossID family membership is not independent-eye eligibility.

implemented: Dedicated Peep controller with externally weighted creep/ring/jump actions, forms, HP/timing/range/damage values.
Shared bounded swept jump planner with actual 3D position, windup, locked destination, legal landing and retained flight through stun/room re-entry.
Owned eye slots, one-time successful detachment, retry after capacity/placement rejection, no orphan pending spawns, owner-death cleanup without extra kills or loot.
Flying diagonal eye launch, axis reflection at enclosing walls, body reflection, real projectile interception, real explosion direction change.
Cyan initial two eyes and yellow scale/speed/continuous creep, refreshing nearby patches to keep hazard count bounded.
Independent seeded dedicated boss pool for Broken Quarry, preserving native canyon bosses, normal encounter RNG, geometry, tutorial and existing run snapshots.
Original procedural boss geometry, empty eye sockets, form colors, yellow shots/creep, grounded warning marker through flight, boss name/HP HUD.

deathward_adaptations.eye_hp: Local HP=1 sentinel because ordinary damage is rejected; not equivalent to source baseHP=450.
deathward_adaptations.damage: Body 20, eye/shot/creep 10 before existing hostile multiplier 1.25: actual contact 25/12.5. Starting player remains 100 HP / 24 damage.
deathward_adaptations.timing: Local cooldown 2.4, windup .65, flight .85, initial recovery 1.2, component retry .25; existing global/floor pacing also applies.
deathward_adaptations.jump: Local range 6, apex 3.5..6, safe lateral/shorter or in-place alternatives. Complete airborne damage immunity is a declared 3D gameplay choice, NOT a verified Isaac window.
deathward_adaptations.yellow: Speed multiplier 1.25; trail interval .3, radius .7, duration 6. Source only establishes faster and continuous trail, not these constants.
deathward_adaptations.projectiles: Speed 7.5, uniform local random ring orientation; yellow material carries no fire/tar secondary effect.
deathward_adaptations.creep: Radius 2.8, duration 6, surface-projected persistent yellow damage. Terrain/water restrictions and refreshing nearby deposits are local policies.
deathward_adaptations.eyes: Actual raised height over interior cover, walls/gates stay solid; elastic body reflection and bomb direction blend 1.5. These are local 3D collision/physics choices.
deathward_adaptations.pool: Broken Quarry band 1: native weight 5, Peep normal 3/cyan 1/yellow 1. Local distribution, not extracted Isaac spawn probability.
deathward_adaptations.render: Original procedural low-poly geometry; no Isaac sprites/models/audio imported.

unresolved: Chaos Card, Euthanasia, God's Flesh and Little Horn item-specific eye destruction remains unimplemented. Generic debug execution is not parity evidence for these items.
Native attack selection probabilities, exact timing and damage windows are not established by the preserved article/XML sources.
Double-boss/degraded later-stage encounter routes need their own reviewed placement contract; current reachability is the dedicated Caves-equivalent pool only.
Bloat and Bloat Eye encounter remain a separate unfinished port.
All-camera mixed-threat readability, diverse player builds/skill balance, and controlled Linux/WASM performance acceptance remain open.
